stories.title: Ship prompts in build + fix proposals path mismatch
stories.description: Production blockers: (1) tsc build omits src/prompts/*.md so installed sapience-thinking ENOENTs on every pass — inline templates as TS constants; (2) thinking writes proactive-thinking/log.jsonl (derived from logPath) while sapience reads proposals.jsonl — add explicit proposalsPath default matching the reader.

stories.title: Replace kill-based thinking lock
stories.description: The stale-lock path SIGTERM/SIGKILLs the stored pid — which is the gateway's own pid (plugins run in-process), so a leaked lock kills the gateway ~2h later. Replace with signal-free short-TTL (10 min) lock in a lock.ts module; clear lock at register(); no process.kill anywhere.

stories.title: Atomic state writes + corruption quarantine
stories.description: All JSON state files (calibration.json, goals.json, outcomes.json, processed-passes.json, inbox-position.json) are written truncate-in-place and loaders swallow parse errors as empty — a crash can permanently wipe state (goals worst case: corrupt file loads as [] then gets saved). Add a safe-json helper per plugin: writeJsonAtomic (temp+rename) and readJsonSafe (ENOENT → empty; corrupt → quarantine to .corrupt-<ts> + event).

stories.title: Fix delivery: real sessionKey injections + enqueue checks
stories.description: Verified against the SDK: enqueueNextTurnInjection requires {sessionKey, text}; missing sessionKey silently returns {enqueued:false}. All four plugins pass {sessionTarget:"main"} — every delivery in the suite has never worked. Add a shared resolveMainSessionKey(config) helper (agent:<id>:<mainKey>, scope global → "global"), pass sessionKey, check the enqueued flag, and emit a delivery_failed event when false.

stories.title: Fix feedback capture via registerHook("message")
stories.description: Passive capture guards on api.session?.onMessage which doesn't exist in the SDK — dead code, the plugin's headline feature never registers. Use api.registerHook("message", handler) (event.action === "received", content in event.context.content), validate content is a string, record captureMode in the status artifact, and log loudly when the hook surface is missing. Also: guard memoryAdd with try/catch + memory_write_failed event; upsert calibration entries for orphaned feedback instead of dropping them.

stories.title: Goals lifecycle tools + check_goals ordering
stories.description: Goals can never leave "decomposing" — no tool persists approach selection/progress/status, so weekly status never fires. Add goal_select_approach, goal_update, goal_progress tools; decomposition prompt instructs the agent to record the selection. Fix check_goals ordering: save goals before advancing inbox position, per-goal delivery try/catch, validate goal_submit params, validate inbox position file (integer, clamp to size, advance only to last newline). In-process mutex around goals.json read-modify-write.

stories.title: Sapience routing reliability
stories.description: process_proposals: add short-TTL lock (no overlapping runs); reload+merge calibration before save and skip save when unchanged (stop clobbering feedback's writes); timestamp watermark so evicted processed-passes entries can't cause re-delivery of ancient act-tier proposals; .present marker becomes freshness-based (touched every run, >2h = absent for sapience-thinking's fallback check); digest: persist last-digest date (no double fire) and honor configured minutes; per-item delivery tracking so partial failures don't re-run act items.

stories.title: Config validation + hygiene fixes
stories.description: Validate activeHours (HH:MM format, valid IANA timezone, support overnight windows) at register with loud fallback to defaults — invalid config currently disables plugins forever silently. Fix h24 midnight quirk (hourCycle h23). Proper empty-object tool parameter schemas (Type.Object({}) instead of {} as any). Categorize delivery errors separately from parse errors in thinking's record path. Delimit inbox goal text as untrusted data in the decomposition prompt.

stories.title: Log rotation and growth bounds
stories.description: Bound unbounded growth: rotate log.md/action-log.md/feedback.md at size threshold; compact proposals.jsonl when passes are processed; purge expired outcome-tracker entries after N days; make events.jsonl rotation work when sapience isn't installed (thinking rotates its own); prune rotated archives; stop writing outside-hours skip events every 15 min overnight (once per skip transition is enough).

stories.title: Installer + doctor hardening
stories.description: install.sh: bash>=4 guard with clear error; anchored plugin/cron matching (no substring false positives: "sapience" currently matches "sapience-thinking"); validate existing crons' toolsAllow/schedule not just name; offer gateway restart when plugins installed; run `openclaw sapience doctor` as final verification. Doctor: exact-base cron match + legacy-duplicate warn (sapience-thinking-pass shadowing); toolsAllow superset check vs SUITE_CRONS; mtime-freshness no-output detection (works on established installs); artifact touch on every tool run + saner stale threshold; version-skew checks (artifact vs on-disk package, legacy npm-root shadow detection, intra-suite spread).

stories.title: Documentation overhaul
stories.description: Fix wrong base paths everywhere (~/.openclaw/... → agent workspace dir); remove/replace claims about nonexistent features (openclaw thinking resolve, schedule config key, automatic approach recording, processed-passes re-delivery claim); fix "five plugins", fish-in-bash-fence, first-hour expectations. Add: tool-exposure requirement page (the production failure), openclaw sapience doctor docs, cron architecture + manual registration commands, workspace path resolution, gateway-restart guidance, uninstall guide, complete per-plugin config reference from DEFAULT_CONFIG, events.jsonl schema completion, delivery mechanics.
